scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Ah...
Here it is!
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
啊...
找到了！

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Welcome to the Airship~
If you have questions or
need any assistance, please
don't hesitate to ask me or
any one of the other crewmen.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
欢迎乘坐飞空艇~
有任何问题或需要帮助，请随时来问我或其他船员。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
A few days ago, a customer
from Einbroch left this on the
Airship. He called and let us
know that he can't come back
to get it, but he is staying
over at the Einbroch Hotel.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
几天前，一位来自艾音布罗克的乘客把这个东西落在飞空艇上了。
他打电话告诉我们，自己没法回来取，不过目前住在艾音布罗克酒店。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
I know it's a strange
favor to ask, but would
you deliver this to Defru
Ark at the Einbroch Hotel?
Of course, I'll repay you
upon your return.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
这个请求可能有点奇怪，不过你能帮我把东西送到艾音布罗克酒店，交给德弗鲁·阿克吗？
当然，你回来后我会答谢你。

scripts.text: ^3355FFKain Himere has given you a small box.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF凯恩·希梅尔给了你一个小盒子。^000000

scripts.text: About the Airship...
scripts.translation: 关于飞空艇

scripts.text: Leave a Comment
scripts.translation: 留下评论

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Is this your first time flying?
I understand if you feel nervous. Before I worked here, I used to feel the same way. Still, this
Airship is pretty amazing. It's incredible what science can do...
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
这是你第一次乘坐飞空艇吗？
如果你觉得紧张，我能理解。我以前也一样。不过这艘飞空艇确实很厉害，科学的力量真不可思议...

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
You want to hear more
about the Airship? Hmm,
there's not too much that
I know, but let me see...
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
您想多了解一些关于飞空艇的事吗？
嗯，我知道的并不多，不过让我想想...

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
I hear from the scholars
who developed the Airship
technology that just a little
piece of the heart of Ymir
generates the power for
this ship to fly. Incredible...
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
听开发飞空艇技术的学者说，只需一小块尤弥尔之心，就能产生驱动飞空艇的动力。太不可思议了...

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
You know, scientific research
has made living easier and more
comfortable in the Schwarzwald
Republic, much in the way magic
research has changed life in the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
你知道吗，科学研究让修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国的生活变得更加便捷和舒适，就像魔法研究改变了卢恩·米德加兹王国的生活一样。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Well, it's rumored that this
really big corporation runs
this Airship. Supposedly,
they've got their hands in
all sorts of enterprises.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
嗯，听说有家大公司在运营这艘飞空艇。
据说他们涉足各种行业。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Since the Airships are our
form of national transportation,
the higher-ups must be making
a ton of money. It's pretty crazy.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
飞空艇是我国的主要交通工具，高层肯定赚了不少钱。真不得了。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
You wish to leave
a comment about our
service? Tell me your
message and I'll report
it to the higher ups.
To cancel, press '0'.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
您想对我们的服务留下评论吗？
请告诉我您的留言，我会向上级汇报。
如需取消，请按“0”。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
K-Kafra...?
Hmm, maybe I better
not send this up after all...
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
卡...卡普拉...？
嗯，也许我还是别把这条留言往上报了...

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Ah, well, if you have any
helpful criticism about our
service, feel free to leave
me a comment at any time.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
啊，好吧，如果您对我们的服务有任何建设性的批评，请随时给我留言。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Hmmmm...
I see. Well, I'll
send your message
to my superiors as
soon as possible.
Thank you very much.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
嗯...我明白了。
我会尽快把您的留言转达给上级。
非常感谢。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Oh, how are you?
If you don't mind me
asking, where are you
headed this time?
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
哦，您好！
如果不介意的话，请问您这次要去哪里？

scripts.text: About the Airship...
scripts.translation: 关于飞空艇

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
You must really want to know all about the Airship, don't you? I'm sorry, but I don't know much more than what I've already told you.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
您一定很想了解飞空艇的一切吧？很抱歉，除此之外，我也不知道更多了。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
I guess if you'd want to know more, you should study to become a Sage in Juno and do your own Airship research...
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
如果您还想了解更多，不妨去朱诺学习成为贤者，亲自研究飞空艇...

scripts.text: What the hell...?
scripts.translation: 这到底是怎么回事...？

scripts.text: What's wrong?
scripts.translation: 怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
I-I'm sorry...
That was so
unprofessional.
H-have a safe trip
and th-thank you for
using the Airship! ^333333*Sob*^000000
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
对...对不起...我刚才太失态了。
祝您旅途平安，也谢...谢谢您乘坐飞空艇！^333333*呜呜*^000000

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
I'm sorry, but it's
a long story. Plus,
you wouldn't understand...
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
很抱歉，这说来话长。
而且，您也不会明白的...

scripts.text: I have time for a long story.
scripts.translation: 我有时间听长故事

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Alright, I might as well get
this off my chest. I guess it
all started when I was a young
man living in Einbech.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
好吧，我就把心里的话说出来吧。一切大概是从我年轻时住在艾音贝赫开始的。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Those days, I was pretty hot
headed and short tempered,
but working as a miner used to
always bring me a sense of peace. Staking my life with my friends, mining pick in hand. Yeah...
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
那时候我脾气暴躁、容易发火，不过当矿工总能让我平静下来。和朋友们一起拼上性命，手握矿镐下矿...是啊...

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
It might have been dangerous,
but it was good, hard and honest work. You know, the mines that connected to the Einbech lode
used to be everything to our little town. But then, things changed...
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
虽然危险，但那是份辛苦而踏实的工作。连接艾音贝赫矿脉的矿坑曾是我们小镇的一切。可后来，一切都变了...

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
The factories started popping
up and all the ores were moved
to where the smokestacks never
stopped churning. More miners
started working in the factories and the mines became lonelier...
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
工厂接连建起，矿石都被运往烟囱日夜冒烟的地方。越来越多的矿工进了工厂，矿坑也渐渐冷清下来...

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
But I loved working on the
land so much, I kept at it
until the accident happened.
Now I can't use my right arm
the way I used to, so I had to
quit my job as a miner...
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
可我太热爱矿上的工作了，一直干到那场事故发生。
如今我的右臂再也不能像从前那样活动，只好辞去矿工的工作...

scripts.text: I'm sorry to hear that.
scripts.translation: 听到这个我很遗憾

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Yeah...
I was really devastated
when it happened. Those
were probably the worst
years of my entire life.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
是啊...发生那件事时，我真的非常痛苦。
那大概是我人生中最糟糕的几年。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
I couldn't think about
life without mining and
I just lost all enthusiasm
for life. I developed a drinking problem and started shutting out my family. I was so stupid...
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
我无法想象没有采矿的生活，也失去了对生活的热情。我开始酗酒，渐渐疏远家人。我真傻...

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
I still can't believe how
supportive my wife was during
those days. Even when I was at
my lowest, she tried to sooth my sorrow and even took on a job
to support me and our daughter.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
我至今仍难以相信，那段日子里妻子一直那么支持我。即使我跌到谷底，她也努力安慰我，甚至出去工作，养活我和女儿。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
^666666*Sob*^000000 It was only after she
died that I realized how much
she must have suffered. To make
matters worse, I had to leave my daughter behind with a neighbor
while I searched for work...
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
^666666*呜呜*^000000直到她去世，我才明白她承受了多少痛苦。更糟的是，我四处找工作时，只能把女儿托付给邻居...

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
I spent years wandering
from town to town, living
a pretty wild life until I could pick myself up again. And finally, I became an Airship crewman.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
我花了几年时间从一个城镇流浪到另一个城镇，过着相当放荡的生活，直到我重新振作起来。
最后，我成为了飞空艇的船员。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
It's been twenty years
since I've lost my family.
My daughter is somewhere
out there, but I can't even
remember her name...
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
我失去家人已经二十年了。
女儿如今不知身在何处，可我甚至记不起她的名字...

scripts.text: Have you tried looking for her?
scripts.translation: 你试过找她吗？

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
I tried going to the house
where my neighbor had lived,
but they moved out years ago.
I really have no clue where she
could be. But I don't deserve to see her. I was a horrible father!
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
我去过邻居以前住的房子，可他们几年前就搬走了。我完全不知道她现在在哪里。
但我不配见她。我是个糟糕的父亲！

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
^666666*Sob*^000000 I'm sorry you
had to hear all of that,
but I really appreciate that
you've listened to me. Now
tell me, where are you headed?
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
^666666*呜呜*^000000抱歉让你听我说了这么多，但我真的很感激你愿意倾听。
现在告诉我，你要去哪里？

scripts.text: Einbroch
scripts.translation: 艾音布罗克

scripts.text: Juno
scripts.translation: 朱诺

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm heading
to Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我要去艾音布罗克。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Perfect...!
If you don't mind,
would you do a favor
for me? First, let me
find that package...
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
太好了...！
如果不介意的话，能帮我个忙吗？
首先，让我找找那个包裹...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm heading
to Juno.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我要去朱诺。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Ah, I see...
There was something
I needed sent to Einbroch.
Anyway, have a good trip.
Oh, and thanks for listening.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
啊，是吗...
我本来有东西要寄到艾音布罗克。
总之，祝你旅途愉快。
哦，还有，谢谢你愿意听我倾诉。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Oh hello!
Things are a little
hectic right now, but
did you delive-- Oh!
Wait, excuse me! Sir--!
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
哦，你好！
现在有点忙。你是来送...哦！
等等，失礼了！先生——！

scripts.text:
^3355FFKain seems too
busy to speak to
you right now...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF凯恩似乎太忙了，现在没法和你对话...^000000

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Welcome back to the Airship. So did you deliver that little box safely?
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
欢迎回到飞空艇。那个小盒子顺利送到了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, unfortunately. He was away when I got there. Let me give this box back to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没有，很遗憾，我到的时候他不在。我把盒子还给你吧。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Oh...
What should I do now? Oh well, sorry for putting you through so much trouble.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
哦...现在该怎么办呢？算了，抱歉让你白跑一趟。

scripts.text: Casually mention Miner's Song
scripts.translation: 顺口提起“矿工之歌”

scripts.text: Suavely mention Tarsha
scripts.translation: 委婉地提起塔尔莎

scripts.text:
[{0}]
While we're on the topic
of boxes and deliveries,
have you ever heard of
the ''Miner's Song?''
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
说到箱子和送东西，你听说过“矿工之歌”吗？

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
''Miner's Song...''
I miss singing that
while working the mines.
I used to sing it all the time
when I was younger, actually.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
“矿工之歌...”我真怀念在矿坑里干活时唱它的日子。
其实，我小时候经常唱这首歌。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
I think I sang it so
much, I even got my little
daughter to sing it with me~
(But what was her name?!)
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
我大概唱得太多了，连小女儿也跟着我一起唱~
（可她叫什么名字来着？！）

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^333333*Cough cough*
*Cou--TARSHA--Cough*^000000

[Kain Himere]
What the...?
Wait. T-Tarsha...
Why does it feel like that
name means something?
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
怎么回事...？
等等，塔...塔尔莎...
为什么这个名字听起来这么熟悉？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You know...
I met a little girl in Einbroch
who was singing the ''Miner's
Song.'' It seems her mother
Tarsha had taught it to her.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道吗...我在艾音布罗克遇到一个小女孩，她在唱“矿工之歌”。
听说是她妈妈塔尔莎教她的。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Interesting. But usually,
only miners would know 
that song. Does this have
anything to do with me?
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
有意思。可通常只有矿工才会唱那首歌。这和我有什么关系吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, this little girl's mother, Tarsha, learned the song from
her father who might have been
a miner. But he mysteriously
disappeared years ago...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那个小女孩的妈妈塔尔莎，是从她父亲那里学会这首歌的。他可能是名矿工，但几年前神秘失踪了...

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Poor girl...!
Her father just
left her?! Why,
she's just like...
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
可怜的孩子...！
她父亲竟然丢下她走了？天哪，她简直就像...

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Wait...
Sweet Christ...
The miner who taught
Tarsha that song might
have been... ^0000FFme^000000.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
等等...
天哪...
教塔尔莎那首歌的矿工，也许就是...^0000FF我^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, for now, we can't
be too sure. Do you have
anything that might prove
you're Tarsha's father?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，目前我们还不能确定。
你有什么能证明你是塔尔莎父亲的证据吗？

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Ehhmmm...
Before I left own, I buried
some of my stuff underneath
a tree in Einbech. I can't exactly remember where, but my wife's
journal should be there.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
呃...我离开艾音贝赫前，把一些东西埋在一棵树下。
我不记得具体位置了，不过我妻子的日记应该也在那里。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Since my wife kept track
of everything in her journal,
she should have written enough
about our daughter for us to know whether or not this Tarsha could be my long lost daughter.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
因为我妻子把一切都记录在日记里，她应该写了很多关于女儿的事，足以让我们判断这个塔尔莎是否真的是我失散多年的女儿。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Now, I can't really leave
the Airship, so would you help
me by finding that journal and
seeing if Tarsha is really related to me somehow? I'd be grateful
if you could do that for me...
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
我现在实在没法离开飞空艇。你能帮我找到那本日记，确认塔尔莎是否和我有关吗？
如果你愿意帮忙，我会非常感激...

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Would you find my wife's
journal and see if Tarsha
is really my daughter? The
journal should be buried
underneath a tree in Einbech.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
你能找到我妻子的日记，看看塔尔莎是否真的是我的女儿吗？
日记应该埋在艾音贝赫的一棵树下。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou better fulfill Kain's
request by finding his wife's
journal and confronting Tarsha
before you speak to him again.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF先找到他妻子的日记，再去找塔尔莎确认情况，然后再回来见凯恩。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou give his wife's
journal to Kain and tell
him that you learn that Tarsha
is really his daughter and that
she is happily married and is
an inventor in Einbroch.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你把凯恩妻子的日记交给他，并告诉他塔尔莎确实是他的女儿。她如今已婚，生活幸福，是艾音布罗克的一名发明家。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFKain's eyes well
with tears and his
entire body trembles
with unrestrainable joy.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF凯恩热泪盈眶，全身因难以抑制的喜悦而颤抖。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
She must have
had a hard time...
But she doesn't
hate me at all.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
她一定吃了不少苦...可她一点也不恨我。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Rashelle?
Can you see me?
Can I really be this
happy? I'm so sorry,
my love... ^666666*Sob...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
拉谢尔？
你能看到我吗？
我真的可以这么幸福吗？
对不起，我的爱人... ^666666*呜呜...*^000000

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Thank you for all of
your help, youngster.
And please, take this
as a token of my gratitude.
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
谢谢你帮了我这么多，年轻人。
请收下这个，聊表谢意。

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
I know this isn't
much, but please
understand that it's
all I have to give you.
God bless you for all
you've done for me~
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
我知道这不算什么，但这是我能给你的全部了。
愿神明保佑你，感谢你为我做的一切~

scripts.text:
^3355FFHmmm...
It would be better
if you approached
Kain with the Doodled
Letter that you received.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF带上收到的涂鸦信件再去找凯恩，或许会更好。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kain Himere]
Oh, how are you
lately, my friend?
I've been doing great,
especially since you've
helped me find my daughter.
Enjoy your travels~
scripts.translation:
[凯恩·希梅尔]
哦，朋友，最近怎么样？
我过得很好，尤其是你帮我找回女儿之后。祝你旅途愉快~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me...?
^3355FFNo one's here!^000000

[{0}]
This must be the room...
But where the hell is he?
I can't just leave this stuff
here if he won't come back.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
应该是这里...可他到底在哪儿？如果他不回来，我也不能把东西就这么留在这儿。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh well...
I guess I can
just give this
back to Kain
on the Airship.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
算了...我还是把这些东西带回飞空艇还给凯恩吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
While I'm in Einbroch,
I may as well take a look
around here and see if I can
find anything interesting. Still, I can't help but think of Kain
Himere's long lost daughter...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
既然来了艾音布罗克，不妨四处看看有没有什么有趣的东西。不过，我还是忍不住想起凯恩·希梅尔失散多年的女儿...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Maybe...
Just maybe...
I can find some
sort of clue about
where she is. She might
even live here in Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
也许...只是也许...我能找到一些关于她下落的线索。
她甚至可能就住在艾音布罗克。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I think I'll do that.
Maybe even right this
minute. Treat it like
sort of quest or something.
Yeah, that could work.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想我会这么做。
也许就从现在开始。
把它当成某种任务吧。
嗯，这样应该可以。

scripts.text:
[Elle Cherno]
Let's get to work
fear-less comraaades~!
Do our best! Nothing
can stop us, lads~!
scripts.translation:
[艾勒·切尔诺]
开工吧，无所畏惧的同志们~！
大家加油！没有什么能阻挡我们，伙伴们~！

scripts.text: Hello!
scripts.translation: 你好！

scripts.text: What are you singing?
scripts.translation: 你在唱什么歌？

scripts.text:
[Elle Cherno]
Let's get to work
fear-less comraaades~!
Do our best! Nothing
can stop us, lads~!
scripts.translation:
[艾勒·切尔诺]
让我们开始工作吧，无所畏惧的同志们~！
加油！
没有什么能阻挡我们，伙计们~！

scripts.text:
[Elle Cherno]
I like this song lots!
Especially when I yell out
''comrades!'' COMRADES!
scripts.translation:
[艾勒·切尔诺]
我可喜欢这首歌了！
尤其喜欢大声喊“同志们！”
同志们！

scripts.text:
[Elle Cherno]
This...?
It's the ''Miner's Song!''
My mommy taught it to me
and she sings it a lot. Daddy
says it's too noisy, though.
scripts.translation:
[艾勒·切尔诺]
这个...？
这是“矿工之歌”！
是我妈妈教我的，她经常唱。
不过爸爸说太吵了。

scripts.text:
[Elle Cherno]
Mmm, when my mommy sings
this song, sometimes she looks
a little sad. Jus' today she sang it a little and looked like she was gonna cry. ^666666*Gasp!*^000000 Wait, do you
think maybe Mommy's sick?
scripts.translation:
[艾勒·切尔诺]
嗯，妈妈唱这首歌时，有时看起来有点难过。今天她唱了一小段，眼看就要哭了。^666666*倒吸一口气！*^000000等等，你觉得妈妈生病了吗？

scripts.text:
[Elle Cherno]
Oh no, oh no...
Hey, will you go see
if my mommy's okay for me?
Please? Our house is behind
the Hotel, so tell me if she's
not feeling good, promise?
scripts.translation:
[艾勒·切尔诺]
不好了，不好了...你能替我去看看妈妈还好吗？
拜托了？我们家就在旅馆后面。如果她不舒服，记得告诉我，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Elle Cherno]
Our house is right
behind of the Hotel.
Will you go there and
see my mommy for me,
please? I'm worried...
scripts.translation:
[艾勒·切尔诺]
我们家就在旅馆后面。
你能去那里看看我妈妈吗？
拜托了？
我很担心...

scripts.text:
[Elle Cherno]
Hey! I have something
to give you, but you have
tooooo much stuff! Hey,
come back later so I can
give it to you, okay?
scripts.translation:
[艾勒·切尔诺]
嘿！我有东西要给你，可你的东西太多了！
晚点再来拿，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Elle Cherno]
You saw my grandpa?
You're his friend, right?
A-are you gonna see
him later? 'Cuz... cuz...
scripts.translation:
[艾勒·切尔诺]
你见过我爷爷吗？你是他的朋友，对吧？
你...你等会儿会去见他吗？因为...因为...

scripts.text:
[Elle Cherno]
I made this for him.
I don't know how to write,
but I made Grampa a letter
as best as I can. Will you
promise to give this to him
for me, pleeeeeease?
scripts.translation:
[艾勒·切尔诺]
这是我做给他的。我还不会写字，但已经尽力给爷爷写了封信。
你能答应替我交给他吗？拜托了~？

scripts.text:
^3355FFElle put a big
doodled message
into your hands.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF艾勒把一封大大的涂鸦信塞到你手里。^000000

scripts.text:
[Theo Cherno]
You're very kind,
adventurer. There
should be more people
in the world like you.
scripts.translation:
[西奥·切尔诺]
你真是个好心人，冒险者。
世界上应该有更多像你这样的人。

scripts.text:
[Theo Cherno]
Are you sure
that you can find
Tarsha's father? Oh,
you must be a godsend!
scripts.translation:
[西奥·切尔诺]
你确定你能找到塔尔莎的父亲吗？
哦，你真是帮了大忙！

scripts.text:
[Theo Cherno]
I'm so happy
for my wife. I....
I don't know how
I can thank you...
scripts.translation:
[西奥·切尔诺]
我为我的妻子感到高兴。
我...我不知道该怎么感谢你...

scripts.text:
[Theo Cherno]
Hmm...
Can we talk later?
I'm pretty busy trying
to fix this thing at
the moment.
scripts.translation:
[西奥·切尔诺]
嗯...
我们稍后再谈好吗？
我现在正忙着修理这个东西。

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Although most of these
contraptions aren't worth
showing off, we've put a lot
of work in inventing these
machines. So, of course,
they give us pride~
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
虽然这些发明大多不值得炫耀，但我们花了很多心思去发明这些机器。
所以，当然，它们让我们感到自豪~

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Maybe all these little
projects might not be
that impressive, but I like
to think of them as stepping
stones to future achievements.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
也许这些小小的项目并不那么令人印象深刻，但我喜欢把它们看作通往未来成就的垫脚石。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me, ma'am,
but you have a scar
on your shoulder. Is
that from an accident?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打扰一下，女士。你肩膀上有道伤疤，是以前出意外留下的吗？

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Oh, that's an old
injury that happened
years ago. I suppose
I was quite the trouble
maker to the people
who raised me...
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
哦，那是多年前留下的旧伤。我想，抚养我的人当时一定觉得我很让人头疼...

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
You see, I lost my parents
when I was very young. It
was only later when I realized
I was raised by foster parents.
I learned that my real mother
died a long time ago...
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
我很小的时候就失去了父母。后来才知道自己是被养父母抚养长大的，也得知亲生母亲早已去世...

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
As for my father, no
one knows if he's dead
or alive. I tried my best
to my foster parents happy,
but I ended up being too rebellious and giving them grief.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
至于父亲，没人知道他是死是活。我努力想让养父母开心，可最后还是变得叛逆，给他们添了不少麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
I finally left home and
studied mechanics. I met
my husband in school and
it was the greatest thing that
ever happened to me~
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
后来我离开家去学机械。上学时遇到了丈夫，那是我人生中最美好的事~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
By the way, I heard
your daughter singing
some sort of Miner's Song.
Did you teach her that?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
对了，我听说你女儿在唱一首矿工之歌，是你教她的吗？

scripts.text:
[Theo Cherno]
I don't understand
why little Elle likes
such a rowdy, man song.
This is all your fault, Tarsha!
scripts.translation:
[西奥·切尔诺]
我真不明白小艾勒为什么喜欢这种粗犷的男人歌。塔尔莎，这都怪你！

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Oh~hohohoho~
I was too young to
remember it clearly,
but I'm sure my real
father loved that song.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
哦~呵呵呵~我那时太小，记不太清了，但我确信亲生父亲很喜欢那首歌。

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
I barely recall that
he used to sing it while
cleaning our old house.
Yes, I don't remember what
he looked like, but he must
have been a miner at one time.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
我依稀记得他以前会一边打扫老房子，一边唱这首歌。
我不记得他的长相，但他一定当过矿工。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A miner...?
(Wait, that crewman,
Kain Himere! He was
a miner who lost his
daughter! Just maybe...)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
矿工...？
（等等，那个船员凯恩·希梅尔！他也是失去女儿的矿工！难道...）

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...!
Tarsha...
Your father
may still be alive!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
...！
塔尔莎...
你的父亲可能还活着！

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
...What?
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
...什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I've got to go check
something now, but
hopefully I'll be back
soon with good news!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我现在得去确认一件事，希望很快就能带着好消息回来！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Tarsha, I know someone
who might be your father!
Just wait for me and hopefully
I'll bring back good news soon!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
塔尔莎，我认识一个人，他可能是你的父亲！等我一下，我一定尽快带回好消息！

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Oh, welcome back~
So were you able to
bring back good news?
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
哦，欢迎回来~你带回好消息了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why, yes.
Speaking of which,
allow me to... check
something first...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
当然。说到这个，请让我...先确认一件事...

scripts.text: Check her neck.
scripts.translation: 检查她的脖子

scripts.text: Check her hands.
scripts.translation: 检查她的手

scripts.text: Check her legs.
scripts.translation: 检查她的腿

scripts.text: Check her forehead.
scripts.translation: 检查她的额头

scripts.text:
^3355FFUh oh...
Nothing's there!^000000

[Theo Cherno]
H-how rude!
Touching another
man's wife...?!
scripts.translation:
[西奥·切尔诺]
你...你怎么这么无礼！
竟然摸别的男人的妻子...？！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou found
a burn mark on
her hand.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你在她手上发现了一道烧伤疤痕。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's it!
Tarsha, your
father's name is
Kain Himere and he's
working on the Airship
as one of the crewmen.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
就是它！塔尔莎，你父亲叫凯恩·希梅尔，他现在是飞空艇上的一名船员。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
He misses you
a lot and hopes
that you can forgive
him... Someday.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他非常想念你，希望有一天能得到你的原谅...

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Are...
Are you serious?
My father's alive!
Oh thank god! Thank
you so much, adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
你...你是认真的吗？
我父亲还活着！谢天谢地！冒险者，太感谢你了！

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
...........
So that means, my
real name would be
^3131FFTarsha Himere Cherno^000000.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
...........
也就是说，我的真名应该是^3131FF塔尔莎·希梅尔·切尔诺^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Oh, you're a godsend!
I'll never forget what you've
done for me! I must repay
you somehow! But all I know
is mechanical engineering...
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
哎呀，你真是帮了大忙！我永远不会忘记你为我做的一切！我一定要报答你！不过，我只懂机械工程...

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Oh, I know~
If you have any
^3131FFbroken equipment^000000,
I can fix it with this
Expert Repairman. It's
one of our best inventions!
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
哦，我知道了~如果你有^3131FF损坏的装备^000000，我可以用这台专家修理机帮你修好。这可是我们最棒的发明之一！

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
I must go and see
my real father soon!
I've missed him for years!
Thank you again for all
you've done for my family~
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
我得尽快去见亲生父亲！我好多年没见他了！再次感谢你为我们一家做的一切~

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Oh, and before you
go, would you go see
Elle again? She wanted to
talk to you for some reason.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
对了，你走之前能再去看看艾勒吗？她好像有事想和你说。

scripts.text:
^3355FFUh oh...
Nothing's there!^000000

[Theo Cherno]
H-how rude!
Touching another
man's wife...?!
scripts.translation:
[西奥·切尔诺]
你...你怎么这么无礼！
竟然摸别人的妻子...？！

scripts.text:
^3355FFUh oh...
Nothing's there!^000000

[Theo Cherno]
H-how rude!
Touching another
man's wife...?!
scripts.translation:
[西奥·切尔诺]
你...你怎么这么无礼！
竟然摸别人的妻子...？！

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
I've been feeling great
after all you've done for
us. Once again, I'd like to
thank you, kind adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
多亏你为我们做了这么多，我感觉好多了。再次谢谢你，善良的冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
I'm sorry, but
we're pretty busy.
Please excuse us~
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
抱歉，但我们现在很忙。
请原谅我们~

scripts.text:
[Theo Cherno]
Honey...
I think there's
a critical structural
problem with the joint.
scripts.translation:
[西奥·切尔诺]
亲爱的...我觉得连接处有严重的结构问题。

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
They must not
be connected right.
Maybe if we... Hmmm.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
它们肯定没接好。
也许我们可以...嗯。

scripts.text:
[Theo Cherno]
Well, let's call
it a day and finish
this tomorrow, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[西奥·切尔诺]
好了，今天就到此为止，明天再继续吧？

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Oh~
I didn't know we
had a guest. Hello,
how are you doing?
Are you interested in
any of our inventions?
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
哦~我不知道家里来了客人。你好，最近怎么样？对我们的发明感兴趣吗？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么

scripts.text: Your daughter asked me to visit you.
scripts.translation: 你女儿让我来拜访你

scripts.text:
[Theo Cherno]
Oh yes, my wife are
I are keeping ourselves
busy by conducting research.
We're trying to invent new
things for better living.
It's what we do...
scripts.translation:
[西奥·切尔诺]
是啊，我和妻子正忙着研究，想发明能让生活更便利的新东西。这就是我们的工作...

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Hahaha, Elle?
Why would our
daughter send
you to visit us?
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
哈哈哈，艾勒？
她为什么会派你来拜访我们呢？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, uh...
She wanted me to
check if her mom
was sick or sad
...Or something?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，那个...她让我来看看妈妈是不是生病了，或者心情不好...之类的？

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Oh my god...!
What is she thinking?
I apologize for troubling
you over this kind of silly
mistake, adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
天哪...！她在想什么呢？很抱歉让你为这种小误会跑一趟，冒险者！

scripts.text:
[Theo Cherno]
But wait, darling.
I agree that sometimes
you look like the loneliest
person in the world, gazing
out that window with those
impossibly wistful eyes.
scripts.translation:
[西奥·切尔诺]
不过，亲爱的，我得承认，有时你望着窗外时，眼神惆怅得像是全世界最孤独的人。

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Oh, I must be
making my family
very anxious. But
don't you worry, love.
I'm very happy with
you and Elle.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
哦，我一定让家人担心了。不过别担心，亲爱的，我和你还有艾勒在一起很幸福。

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
And...
Kind adventurer,
may I ask your name?
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
对了...善良的冒险者，可以告诉我你的名字吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am called,
{1}.

[Tarsha Cherno]
{0},
I appreciate your
concern for us. Would
you stay for a cup of tea?
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
{0}，谢谢你关心我们。愿意留下来喝杯茶吗？

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Now, please pardon the
mess. My husband and I are
mechanical engineers focused
on creating machines that would
reduce the risk of mining ores.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
请原谅这里有些凌乱。我和丈夫都是机械工程师，专门研究能降低采矿风险的机器。

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Since we work at home, we
can't avoid having machine
parts lying here and there
sometimes. In any case, we're
hoping we create a machine that could make miners' lives safer...
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
我们在家工作，机器零件难免会散落各处。总之，我们希望造出能让矿工工作更安全的机器...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah...
So that's why
there's so many
interesting things
in your house...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊...原来你家里这些有趣的东西都是这么来的...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou begin to
take a look around
the Cherno household.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你开始打量切尔诺一家。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's...
It's a really
strange looking
machine. Does it
even do anything?^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这...是一台外观古怪的机器。它到底能做什么？^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's a mirror.
So, of course the
first thing you'll
see is yourself.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这是一面镜子。你第一个看到的当然是自己。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh wow...
I look pretty good.
No wait. Really, really
good. So this must be
why I get such great
service at restaurants...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇...我看起来真不错。等等，不，是非常好看！这一定就是我在餐厅总能享受到超棒服务的原因...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Man...
I didn't know
I was so good
looking! Ooh yah~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
天哪...我都不知道自己这么帅！哦耶~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Whoa...
So that's why the
ladies keep looking
at me. I'm a walking
free gun show!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇...原来女士们总盯着我看是因为这个。我简直是行走的免费肌肉秀！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's a shame I can't job
change to Male Model.
Clearly, I'd be like, Job
Level 87 or something.
Man, I'm beautiful...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
可惜我不能转职成男模。照这条件，我至少也有87级吧。天哪，我真美...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This is my reflection?!
No one can be this good
looking, not without special
effects! I mean, it's not
fair to everyone else...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这是我的倒影？！不加特效，怎么可能有人这么好看！这对别人也太不公平了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh. Wow.
I never realized...
Everything is in
perfect proportion!
No wonder people
want to party with me~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇...我以前怎么没发现...我的身材比例简直完美！难怪大家都想和我组队~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh my gosh~
How can I look this
good without any makeup?
I-It isn't fair to all the other
girls... Wow, is this really me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
天哪~我没化妆怎么能这么好看？这...这对其他女生也太不公平了...哇，这真的是我吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Am I going crazy?
Is that girl in the
mirror really me...?
How did I not realize
how gorgeous I look?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是不是疯了？镜子里那个女孩真的是我...？我怎么一直没发现自己这么漂亮？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So...
What did you do with
this mirror? Because I'm
looking at my reflection
and I can't seem to find
any flaws with my figure...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那么...你对这面镜子做了什么？我看着自己的倒影，完全找不到身材上的缺点...

scripts.text:
[Tarsha Cherno]
Actually...
That's not one
of our inventions.
It's just a normal mirror...
scripts.translation:
[塔尔莎·切尔诺]
其实...那不是我们的发明，只是一面普通镜子...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well now...!
Are you sure?
Because my face looks
freakin' immaculate! And
it's like, I'm almost too sexy!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哎呀...！你确定吗？我的脸简直完美无瑕！我都快性感得过头了！

scripts.text:
^3355FFAfter enjoying that
little epiphany, you
see a reflection of
Tarsha's neck as you
set the mirror back down.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你回过神来，把镜子放下时，瞥见了塔尔莎脖子的倒影。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAs you take a closer
look, you find that there's
a strange mark around her
neck. What ever could it mean?^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你凑近细看，发现她脖子上有个奇怪的印记。那究竟意味着什么？^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou crouch down
under the tree and
begin digging into
the ground.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你蹲到树下，开始挖土。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355ffUnfortunately,
you weren't able
to find anything.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355ff很遗憾，你什么也没找到。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou have found a journal
among some other articles
that have been buried by Kain.
You open the journal and begin
to read what's written inside.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你在凯恩埋下的物品中找到一本日记。
你打开日记，开始阅读里面的内容。^000000

scripts.text: ^3355FFThat was the last page of the journal. You picked it up so that you can bring it over to ^3131FFTarsha.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF这已经是日记的最后一页。你拿起日记，准备带去给^3131FF塔尔莎。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou open
the journal
and begin to read...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你打开日记，开始阅读...^000000

scripts.text:
<Date : OX OX>
^856363I'm sooo happy
to be with Kain.
He's such an honest,
sincere man, even if
he is quiet sometimes.
scripts.translation:
<日期：OX OX>
^856363能和凯恩在一起，我真的太幸福了。
他诚实又真挚，虽然有时不太爱说话。

scripts.text:
^856363Although he's a very
good husband to me,
I'm not so good at being
a housewife. But I'll do
my very best for us both.
scripts.translation: ^856363他是个好丈夫，可我不太擅长料理家务。不过，我会尽全力照顾好我们两个人。

scripts.text:
<Date : OX OX>
^856363I fell asleep while
fixing dinner and burned
all the food. How can I be
so careless? But Kain ate
every bite, even if he had
to pretend that he liked it.^000000
scripts.translation:
<日期：OX OX>
^856363我做晚饭时睡着了，把菜全烧焦了。我怎么这么粗心？凯恩还是把饭菜全吃光了，哪怕他得假装喜欢。^000000

scripts.text:
<Date : OX OX>
^856363Kain and I will be having
a child soon! I'm so happy,
but I'm also a little worried
sometimes. Kain is all smiles
though, and he gives me relief.^000000
scripts.translation:
<日期：OX OX>
^856363凯恩和我很快就要有孩子了！我很开心，但有时也有点担心。凯恩却总是笑容满面，让我安心不少。^000000

scripts.text:
<Date : OX OX>
^856363More people have been
leaving the mines to work
for the new factories, many
of them Kain's friends. I think
Kain's pride was pretty hurt.
I wonder how I can help him?^000000
scripts.translation:
<日期：OX OX>
^856363越来越多的人离开矿山，去新工厂工作，其中不少是凯恩的朋友。我想这伤了凯恩的自尊。我该怎么帮他呢？^000000

scripts.text:
<Date : OX OX>
^856363Kain and I are now the
proud parents of a beautiful
baby girl. We named her ^000000Tarsha^856363
and she has her father's eyes.
I'm going to be the best mother
that I can possibly be for her.
scripts.translation:
<日期：OX OX>
^856363凯恩和我如今有了一个漂亮的女儿。我们给她取名^000000塔尔莎^856363，她有一双和父亲一样的眼睛。我要尽力做个好母亲。

scripts.text:
<Date : OX OX>
^856363Tarsha called me
''Mommy'' for the first
time! It's a miracle!
I want nothing else in
the world but for her to
be happy and healthy.^000000
scripts.translation:
<日期：OX OX>
^856363塔尔莎第一次叫我“妈妈”了！真是奇迹！我别无所求，只希望她健康快乐。^000000

scripts.text:
<Date : OX OX>
^856363Kain got into an accident
at the mine. While they were
digging ores, toxic gas was
released somehow. It wasn't
lethal, but Kain's arm has
been partly paralyzed...^000000
scripts.translation:
<日期：OX OX>
^856363凯恩在矿场出了事故。挖矿时不知为何泄漏了有毒气体。虽然没有生命危险，但凯恩的一只手臂部分瘫痪了...^000000

scripts.text:
^856363When the doctor said that
it may even affect his memories
later, he became so depressed.
I tried to make him feel better
by making his favorite soup.
He smiled, but I could tell...^000000
scripts.translation: ^856363医生说这甚至可能影响他的记忆，他因此非常沮丧。我做了他最喜欢的汤，想让他好受些。他笑了，可我看得出来...^000000

scripts.text:
^856363I could tell he's
not alright with this.
I hope he feels better
soon. His despair is
at least as great as his
passion for his job.^000000
scripts.translation: ^856363我看得出他无法接受这件事。希望他能早日好起来。他对工作的热情有多强烈，绝望就有多深。^000000

scripts.text:
<Date : OX OX>
^856363Kain's drinking is
getting worse. He comes
home too often screaming
and yelling. There's too
much anger in him and he's
not the same anymore...
scripts.translation:
<日期：OX OX>
^856363凯恩酗酒越来越严重了。他回家时总是大喊大叫，满腔怒火，已经变得不像从前的他了...

scripts.text:
<Date : OX OX>
^856363Tarsha got her hand
scalded from boiling
water while playing in
the kitchen. Although she
was treated, she'll always
have that ^000000burn mark^856363.^000000
scripts.translation:
<日期：OX OX>
^856363塔尔莎在厨房玩耍时，被开水烫伤了手。虽然接受了治疗，但那道^000000烧伤疤痕^856363会永远留下。^000000

scripts.text:
^856363After we got home from
the doctor's, Tarsha laughed
and played with her doll as if
nothing ever happened. But for
some reason, I couldn't stop
myself from crying...^000000
scripts.translation: ^856363从医生那里回来后，塔尔莎像什么都没发生过一样，笑着玩起了娃娃。不知为何，我却忍不住哭了起来...^000000

scripts.text:
<Date : OX OX>
^856363Kain comes home less
nowadays. I've had to
start working in the store
after we spent all of our
savings. It's tough working
and taking care of the family.
scripts.translation:
<日期：OX OX>
^856363最近凯恩越来越少回家。积蓄花光后，我只好去店里工作。一边工作一边照顾家庭，实在辛苦。

scripts.text:
^856363Still, it's all worth
it to see Tarsha's smile.
But I can never stop worrying
about my poor, dear Kain...
scripts.translation: ^856363不过，只要看到塔尔莎的笑容，一切都值得。可我总是忍不住担心我可怜的凯恩...

scripts.text:
<Date : OX OX>
^856363Everyday, I feel weaker
and weaker, as if I die
just a little more each day.
I wanted to tell Kain about
what the doctor said, but he's
not ready for this news yet...^000000
scripts.translation:
<日期：OX OX>
^856363我一天比一天虚弱，仿佛每天都离死亡更近一些。我想告诉凯恩医生说的话，可他还没准备好接受这个消息...^000000

scripts.text:
^856363Lately, Tarsha cries
a lot. My poor baby loves
her father, but he's always
so distant. But sometimes,
I see him sadly smile for
Tarsha, if only for a moment.^000000
scripts.translation: ^856363最近塔尔莎总是哭。可怜的孩子很爱父亲，可他总是那么疏远。不过有时我也能看到他为了塔尔莎勉强露出悲伤的笑容，哪怕只有一瞬间。^000000

^3355FF这似乎是某种奇怪的机器。
完全看不出它有什么功能或用途。^000000

scripts.text:
[Tarlock]
I am Tarlock,
captain of this
Airship. Go and
fight with the
Gremlins!
scripts.translation:
[塔洛克]
我是塔洛克，这艘飞空艇的船长。去和小妖精们战斗吧！

scripts.text:
[Tarlock]
I am Tarlock,
captain of this
Airship. Did you
have a question?
scripts.translation:
[塔洛克]
我是塔洛克，这艘飞空艇的船长。
你有什么问题吗？

scripts.text: Y-you're a reindeer?!
scripts.translation: 你...你是驯鹿？！

scripts.text: No, not really.
scripts.translation: 不，不是。

scripts.text:
[Tarlock]
Hm? Oh, that
We reindeer are a proud
race who like to travel the
world. But that should be
obvious if you think of the
reindeer working for Claus.
scripts.translation:
[塔洛克]
嗯？哦，我们驯鹿一族热爱旅行，以此为傲。想想为克劳斯工作的驯鹿，你就明白了。

scripts.text:
[Tarlock]
Well, reindeer or
not, I've earned the
captaincy of this ship
and the loyalty of my crew.
We'll do everything we can to
make sure your flight is safe.
scripts.translation:
[塔洛克]
不管是不是驯鹿，我都凭本事当上了船长，也赢得了船员的忠心。
我们会尽一切努力确保你的旅途安全。

scripts.text:
[Tarlock]
Mm...?
Didn't you ask me that
before? Are you just curious
or did you really want to know?
scripts.translation:
[塔洛克]
嗯...？
你之前不是问过我这个问题吗？
你只是好奇，还是真的想知道？

scripts.text:
[Tarlock]
Um... Ha ha ha~!
This guy, he is a real lover!
But his true inner man
is limited by his duty.
What do you think?
Hoh hoh hoh.
scripts.translation:
[塔洛克]
呃...哈哈哈~！
这家伙可真痴情！
不过，他真正的内心被职责束缚住了。
你觉得呢？呵呵呵。

scripts.text:
[Tarlock]
Yes, I finished.
Even if I understand him
I've a totally different
point of view. But both
of us are fearless.
scripts.translation:
[塔洛克]
是的，我写完了。
虽然我理解他的想法，但我的观点完全不同。不过我们两人都无所畏惧。

scripts.text:
[Tarlock]
Mm...?
Didn't you ask me that
before? Well, in any case
I apologize, but I'm still not
allowed to tell you that secret.
scripts.translation:
[塔洛克]
嗯...？
你之前不是问过我这个问题吗？
总之，我很抱歉，但我仍然不能告诉你那个秘密。

scripts.text:
[Tarlock]
Oh!
And he answer you? Really?!
In fact, I wasn't
expecting that too much...
Please wait a little,
I'll read his letter.
scripts.translation:
[塔洛克]
哦！他回信了？真的吗？！
其实我没抱太大希望...
稍等，我来读读他的信。

scripts.text:
[Tarlock]
Didn't I teach you before?
I won't explain such a long
tale again!
scripts.translation:
[塔洛克]
我之前不是教过你吗？
我不会再解释这么长的故事了！

scripts.text:
[Tarlock]
Hahahah! Don't worry, I'll
tell you know this Airship
flies once you deliver that
letter to my brother, Ferlock,
and bring back his reply.
scripts.translation:
[塔洛克]
哈哈哈！别担心。你把这封信交给我弟弟裴陆，再带回他的回信，我就告诉你这艘飞空艇是怎么飞的。

scripts.text:
[Tarlock]
Hahaha! How this
Airship flies? Yes, it's
quite wonderful, isn't it?
Although that's a secret,
let me assure you that it's
nothing weird or dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[塔洛克]
哈哈哈！飞空艇是怎么飞的？确实很奇妙吧？
虽然这是个秘密，但我保证没什么奇怪或危险的。

scripts.text: No, not really...
scripts.translation: 不，不太行

scripts.text: Yes, I really want to know!
scripts.translation: 是的，我真的想知道！

scripts.text:
[Tarlock]
Hahahaha~
Maybe someday you'll
figure out how this Airship
is able to stay aloft and
fly through the skies.
scripts.translation:
[塔洛克]
哈哈哈~也许有一天，你会弄清楚这艘飞空艇如何悬浮在空中、穿越云霄。

scripts.text:
[Tarlock]
In all honestly, the
secret to this Airship's
flight is something that
only captains are authorized
to know. So I shouldn't really
tell you anything about it.
scripts.translation:
[塔洛克]
老实说，飞空艇的飞行原理是机密，只有船长才有权知晓。所以我本不该告诉你。

scripts.text:
[Tarlock]
But I've never been able
to trust upper management
so I don't have any loyalty to
them. I wouldn't mind telling
you that classified info if you
do a little favor for me first.
scripts.translation:
[塔洛克]
不过我从不信任公司高层，对他们也谈不上忠诚。你先帮我一个小忙，我倒不介意把这份机密告诉你。

scripts.text: Let me think about it.
scripts.translation: 让我考虑一下

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然

scripts.text:
[Tarlock]
Alright. But don't
worry, I'm not going
to ask you to do anything
that you can't handle. Come
back after you decide, alright?
scripts.translation:
[塔洛克]
好的。
但别担心，我不会让你做你无法处理的事情。
等你决定好了再回来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Tarlock]
Ha-hah! I like you
already! Alright, here's
the deal. I have a younger
brother who I rarely see since
he's also an Airship Captain
that's always traveling.
scripts.translation:
[塔洛克]
哈哈！我开始喜欢你了。事情是这样的：我有个弟弟，也是一名飞空艇船长，总在外奔波，所以我们很少见面。

scripts.text:
[Tarlock]
Would you bring this
letter to my brother,
Ferlock? Also, please
make sure that you come
back with his reply, alright?
Thank you, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[塔洛克]
能帮我把这封信带给弟弟裴陆，再把他的回信带回来吗？谢谢你，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Tarlock]
Oh, and once you meet
my brother, please help
him out. He'll explain it
once you see him.
scripts.translation:
[塔洛克]
对了，见到我弟弟后也请帮帮他。他会当面跟你解释。

scripts.text:
^3131FFYou have received
Captain Tarlock's letter
to deliver to his younger
brother, Captain Ferlock.
scripts.translation: ^3131FF你收到塔洛克船长的信，要替他交给弟弟裴陆船长。

scripts.text:
^3131ffHe continue reading
the letter.^000000

[Tarlock]
Oh, I almost forgot,
I'll teach you what you
wanted to know.
scripts.translation:
[塔洛克]
哦，我差点忘了。来告诉你想知道的事吧。

scripts.text:
[Tarlock]
The Airship's secret to float is...
The large boiler is setted on fire,
That moves the pistons, gears
and turbines with the steam
that is generated when the water
passes within the boiler.
scripts.translation:
[塔洛克]
飞空艇能飞起来的秘密是...锅炉加热产生蒸汽，推动活塞、齿轮和涡轮机。水流经锅炉后便会产生蒸汽。

scripts.text:
[Tarlock]
That turns the propeller.
That's all. Did you understand?
scripts.translation:
[塔洛克]
然后螺旋桨就转起来了。就是这么回事，明白了吗？

scripts.text: Um? Only that? There's no more?
scripts.translation: 嗯？就这样？没有别的了？

scripts.text:
[Tarlock]
Ha ha ha!
I explained it roughly to
make it easier to understand
by you. Still, you aren't
pleased? I said it in plain
english that everyone could
understand.
scripts.translation:
[塔洛克]
哈哈哈！我只是尽量讲得简单些，让你容易理解。怎么，你还不满意？我可是用大家都听得懂的大白话解释的。

scripts.text:
[Tarlock]
Obviously, only with a steam
is impossible to make this fly.
Therefore, it uses an amplifier
called ^ff0000Rune Mechanism^000000.
scripts.translation:
[塔洛克]
显然，光靠蒸汽不可能让飞空艇飞起来。因此还要用一种叫作^ff0000符文装置^000000的增幅器。

scripts.text: Uh? What's a Rune Mechanism?
scripts.translation: 咦？什么是符文装置？

scripts.text:
[Tarlock]
It's a device that uses a
magic stone as power source.
However, I don't know how
this work...
I forgot the details probably
because I didn't paid much attention.
scripts.translation:
[塔洛克]
那是一种以魔法石为能源的装置。不过我不知道它具体怎么运作...大概是因为我当时没认真听，所以忘了细节。

scripts.text:
[Tarlock]
The only I remember is
that the energy is amplified
while it passes through the
Rune that is attached to a
steam engine.
scripts.translation:
[塔洛克]
我只记得，能量通过装在蒸汽机上的符文时会得到增幅。

scripts.text:
[Tarlock]
In fact, all this airship
floats thanks to the power
given by the stone, no
exaggeration.
It has really a strong power.
scripts.translation:
[塔洛克]
说真的，这艘飞空艇完全靠那块石头的力量悬浮，一点也不夸张。那力量可强着呢。

scripts.text:
[Tarlock]
Did you understand?
I'll rest a little.
I'm tired for reading
and writing those long
letters.
scripts.translation:
[塔洛克]
你明白了吗？我得休息一会儿。读写那么长的信可把我累坏了。

scripts.text:
[Tarlock]
Alright, then.
Thanks for flying
with us, and I hope
you enjoy your travels.
scripts.translation:
[塔洛克]
好了，就这样。感谢乘坐我们的飞空艇，祝你旅途愉快。

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
Welcome to the airship. I am the captain Ferlock.
Is there anything that I can help you with today?
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
欢迎乘坐飞空艇。我是船长裴陆。今天有什么需要帮忙的吗？

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
Ah, thank you for coming.
Now, I wanted to ask you
why you were investigating
Ymir's Heart Piece. Are you
merely curious, or did you
have some special reason?
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
啊，谢谢你过来。我想问问，你为什么在调查尤弥尔之心碎片？只是好奇，还是另有原因？

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
Now, {0},
you must be wondering
why I'm telling you all
this. I believe that some
party wishes to steal the
Rune Stones from the Airships.
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
{0}，你一定想知道我为什么告诉你这些吧。我怀疑有人想从飞空艇上偷走符文石。

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
Hey there, welcome
aboard the Airship. I'm
Ferlock, your captain
on this flight. How can
I be of service to you?
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
欢迎登上飞空艇。我是本次航班的船长裴陆，有什么可以为你效劳？

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
Please tell his fiance where he is.
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
请告诉他的未婚妻他在哪里。

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
I'll be quite busy with my
captaining duties and my
private investigation of the
attempted Rune Stone robberies.
Hopefully, we'll be able to meet again later. For now, take care.
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
我得忙船长的工作，还要私下调查符文石盗窃未遂案。希望以后还能再见。保重。

scripts.text: I am looking for a man named Thierry.
scripts.translation: 我在找一个叫蒂埃里的人

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
Thierry? Well, I do not think that I know that person.
I can guarantee you at least that he is not working for me.
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
蒂埃里？我不记得认识这个人。至少可以肯定，他不是我的船员。

scripts.text: Will you let me check the history of passenger lists?
scripts.translation: 能让我查看一下乘客名单的历史记录吗？

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
I am sorry, but I cannot release such personal information to an unauthorized person.
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
很抱歉，未经授权，我不能透露这类个人信息。

scripts.text: - Captain Ferlock was carefully listening to you while you were explaining the reason why you have been looking for Thierry. -
scripts.translation: - 船长裴陆认真听你讲述了寻找蒂埃里的缘由。 -

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
Ummm....I see, I fully understand the siatuation. But, this is my situation that I am not allowed to release our passenger lists to unauthorized people...
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
嗯...我明白了，也完全理解你的处境。不过，我不能把乘客名单透露给未经授权的人...

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
*Sigh*....I guess that rules exist only to be broken one of these days... Okay, I will let you check our passenger lists. Please give me a moment.
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
*叹气*...规矩总有一天也得打破吧...好吧，我让你查乘客名单。稍等片刻。

scripts.text:
- Captain Ferlock took out a heavy book from somewhere, and wrote the name 'Thierry' on the first blank page. -
- As the letters slowly disappeared, pages of the book started being turned by themselves. -
scripts.translation:
- 船长裴陆不知从哪里拿出一本厚书，在第一页空白处写下“蒂埃里”。 -
- 字迹渐渐消失，书页随即自行翻动起来。 -

scripts.text: - The pages stopped turning at a page that the name 'Thierry' was written on. -
scripts.translation: - 书页翻到写有“蒂埃里”的那一页，停了下来。 -

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
Haha, you must be surprised by this, huh? As you see, this book is a magic book which you do not need to turn the pages to find a specific page.
Well, this is how we, Schwarzwald Republicans adopt magic in their lives.
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
哈哈，你一定很惊讶吧？这是一本魔法书，不用手动翻页就能找到指定页面。
这就是修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德人将魔法融入日常生活的方式。

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
My old friend has given me this....well, it is not important at this moment anyways.
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
这是我的一位老朋友送的...算了，现在说这个不重要。

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
Let's see, Thierry, Thierry.... Yes, he was in the airship about a month ago. He was heading to Hugel, and he was one of the very first passengers of the Hugel route.
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
我看看，蒂埃里...是的，他大约一个月前乘坐过这艘飞空艇，前往毁葛，是毁葛航线最早一批乘客之一。

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
....Oh, did you say that he was good at researching stuffs? Now I remember him, he was the guy!
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
...哦，你说他擅长研究？我想起来了，就是那个人！

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
It was the very first day that we operated the Hugel route. While we were heading to Hugel, a group of dragons raided our airship. 
We were unprepared for a such attack, so basically we were at the very dangerous moment.
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
那是毁葛航线开通的第一天。我们正飞往毁葛时，一群龙袭击了飞空艇。
我们毫无准备，情况十分危急。

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
It was all my fault because I knew that dragons were one of the reasons why people had not dared to visit Hugel.
How stupid of me! Even until then, I did not even think twice about preparing our crews for those brutal dragons' attacks.
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
这都是我的错。我明明知道龙是人们不敢去毁葛的原因之一，却没为船员做好应对龙袭的准备。我真蠢！

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
So the dragons seriously damaged our airship, and we were about to fall into the ground. Then this young man came forward and repaired the airship as if he knew that it would be coming.
I am very sure that Thierry was that guy who saved our lives.
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
龙把飞空艇严重损坏，我们差点坠毁。就在这时，一位年轻人挺身而出，及时修好了飞空艇。
我敢肯定，救了我们性命的就是蒂埃里。

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
At that time, I wondered what made him look so sad and depressed. And now I know why.
I am so glad that I decided to help you in finding this amazing guy. Now you can go tell his fiance where he is.
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
当时我还纳闷他为何如此悲伤，现在终于明白了。
我很高兴能帮你找到他。现在你可以去告诉他的未婚妻他在哪里了。

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
If you meet him, please send my regard to him.
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
如果你见到他，请代我向他问好。

scripts.text: Just curious...
scripts.translation: 只是好奇

scripts.text: Well, there's someone I need to help...
scripts.translation: 嗯，我有个人需要帮忙

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
Just curious...?
I don't know if satisfying
your curiosity is worth the
risks that you have already
taken. You should be more 
careful in the future...
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
只是好奇...？我不确定，为满足好奇心而冒这么大风险是否值得。以后可得小心些...

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
Well, I shouldn't be
trusting you this much,
but since you've helped
me and my brother, I feel
that you must be one of those altruistic adventurers. Very well.
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
我本不该这么信任你，但既然你帮过我和弟弟，我想你是个乐于助人的冒险者。好吧。

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
If you promise that you'll
never tell what I reveal to
you, then I suppose I can
tell you know about the Rune
Stone and Ymir's Heart Piece.
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
如果你保证绝不泄露我告诉你的事，我就告诉你符文石和尤弥尔之心碎片的秘密。

scripts.text: I promise...
scripts.translation: 我保证

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
Alright, then. I expect you
to keep your word. Now, you
already know that the Airships
are powered by Rune Stones, imitations of Ymir's Heart pieces.
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
好，我相信你会守信。你已经知道飞空艇由符文石驱动，而符文石是仿造尤弥尔之心碎片制造的。

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
Although Rune Stones are
inferior to true Ymir Heart
pieces, we can make as many
as want. As for true Ymir Heart
Pieces, they're difficult to find or effectively reproduce.
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
符文石虽然不如真正的尤弥尔之心碎片，但可以大量制造。真正的碎片却很难找到，也几乎无法复制。

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
You may have already
figured this out, but all
Rune Stones are produced
in the Einbroch Laboratory
for use in the Airships. So
you see what's going on?
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
你或许已经猜到了，所有供飞空艇使用的符文石都产自艾音布罗克实验室。你明白这意味着什么吧？

scripts.text: Wait, what's the Varmunt Project?
scripts.translation: 等等，巴尔蒙德计划是什么？

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
The Varmunt Project is
a continuation of one of
the projects started by the
great Sage, Varmunt. Even as
a child, he was renown as an
incredible genius, a prodigy.
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
巴尔蒙德计划是伟大贤者巴尔蒙德所启动项目的延续。他还是个孩子时，就已是闻名遐迩的天才神童。

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
However, no matter how
much academic success he
enjoyed--he even became a
tenured professor at Juno
University--Varmunt was never able to finance his own research.
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
然而，不管他学术成就多高——甚至成了朱诺大学的终身教授——都没法为自己的研究筹措资金。

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
Eventually, he accepted an
offer from Rekenber Co. to
develop an energy source in
exchange for funding. The
result of his work for them is the invention of the Rune Stone.
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
最终，他接受雷根贝勒公司的提议，以研发能源换取资金。他为公司工作的成果，就是发明了符文石。

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
However, the public isn't
supposed to know that Varmunt
invented the Rune Stones. Now,
Varmunt disappeared before he
could perfect the Rune Stone
creation process.
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
然而，公众并不知道符文石是巴尔蒙德发明的。他还没来得及完善符文石的制造工艺，就失踪了。

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
Therefore, the Rune Stones
we have now are unstable and
become useless after a while.
The Varmunt Project aims to
correct these flaws and perfect
the Ymir Heart replication...
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
因此，现有的符文石并不稳定，用一段时间就会失效。巴尔蒙德计划旨在修正这些缺陷，完善尤弥尔之心的复制技术...

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
Er, anyway, that's why
I was at the Einbroch
Laboratory today. My Rune
Stone was close to empty,
so I went there to pick up
a fully charged one.
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
呃，总之，这就是我今天去艾音布罗克实验室的原因。我的符文石快耗尽了，所以去领一块充满能量的。

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
^333333*Phew...*^000000
Would you give me
a moment to catch
my breath before
I continue? Yes,
there's a little more...
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
^333333*呼...*^000000
让我喘口气再继续好吗？还有一点要说...

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
Have you noticed the
Gremlins and Beholders
that attack my brother's
ship? Believe it or not,
Gremlins are usually just
harmless and mischievous.
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
你注意到袭击我弟弟飞空艇的小妖精和恶魔之眼了吗？不骗你，小妖精通常无害，只是有些调皮。

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
Gremlin wings also aren't
naturally powerful enough to
enable them to fly. However,
if someone implants Wills of
the Darkness into them, their
powers increase exponentially.
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
小妖精的翅膀本身不足以让它们飞起来。但要是有人把黑暗意志植入它们体内，它们的力量就会暴涨。

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
Although Gremlins tend
not to attack humans unless
provoked, and that they tend
to shy away from people, they
are being controlled to steal
our Airships' Rune Stones.
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
小妖精通常不会主动攻击人类，也会躲着人走，可如今它们受人操纵，正在偷我们的飞空艇符文石。

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
Whoever is controlling the
Gremlins also sends those
Beholder monsters in order
to monitor their progress
and observe our resistance.
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
操纵小妖精的人还派出恶魔之眼监视行动进展，并观察我们的抵抗。

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
My brother and I have been
investigating this matter, but
so far, we haven't learned very
much. Now, my Airship only
provides domestic flights
and hasn't been attacked.
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
我和弟弟一直在调查这件事，但目前所知不多。我的飞空艇只运营国内航线，还没遭到袭击。

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
Now, my brother's Airship
specializes in international
flights and suffers from the
Gremlin invasions, so we are
guessing the attackers are from outside the Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
弟弟的飞空艇负责国际航线，经常遭到小妖精袭击，所以我们猜袭击者来自修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国之外。

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
In any case, that is all
I really know. Please keep
this information to yourself
and let me know if you learn anything new about this situation.
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
总之，我知道的就这些。请保守秘密，如果发现任何新线索，记得告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
If I manage to uncover
anything about the ones
that are using the Wills
of Darkness to control the
Gremlins and steal our Rune
Stones, I'll let you know.
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
如果我查出是谁利用黑暗意志操纵小妖精、偷走符文石，会告诉你。

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
Who is sending these
monsters to invade our
Airships, and for what
purpose do they want the
Rune Stones? Hmm. Well, this
is goodbye for now, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
究竟是谁派魔物袭击飞空艇？它们偷符文石又有什么目的？嗯，冒险者，暂时就此别过。

scripts.text: How does this Airship fly?
scripts.translation: 这艘飞空艇是如何飞行的？

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
I'm sorry, but I can't
give you that kind of
classified information.
It's too important to the
security and safety of
this Airship, you see.
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
很抱歉，我不能透露这类机密信息。这关系到飞空艇的安全，不能大意。

scripts.text:
^3131FFYou give Captain Ferlock
the letter that his brother
Tarlock has written for him.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3131FF你把塔洛克船长写给裴陆的信交给了他。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
Oh, this is from my
brother? Hey, thanks so
much for bringing this to
me for him. Ah, give me
a minute to read all of
this, would you now?
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
哦，这是我弟弟的信？太感谢你替他送来。给我一点时间读完，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
...
So that's what he's been
up to. Huh. Hahaha! Oh, that's
funny. Ah, it's always good to
hear from Tarlock. Anyway,
I'm sorry to make you wait.
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
...原来他最近在忙这些。哈哈哈！真有意思。收到塔洛克的信总让人高兴。抱歉让你久等了。

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
Anyway, my brother wrote
about the usual stuff, but
he mentioned that he was
hoping to finally return a few
things he borrowed from me.
However, he lost them...
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
总之，我弟弟在信里聊了些近况，还说想把借我的几样东西还回来。结果他把东西弄丢了...

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
It turns that those nasty
gremlins that sometimes
attack his ship stole my
things, so was he actually
hoping that you would
help me get them back.
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
原来那些偶尔袭击他飞空艇的讨厌小妖精偷走了我的东西。他大概是希望你帮我找回来。

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
Yeah, yeah. He specifically
mentioned that I shouldn't
give you my reply until you
hunt those monsters and get
my stuff back. I'm sorry, but
I guess you owe big bro, huh?
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
没错，他特意交代，在你猎杀那些魔物、找回我的东西之前，别把回信交给你。看来你得先帮我哥一个忙，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
Well, if you're willing to
help me, would you get my
^ff00002 Will of the Darkness^000000 and
^ff00002 Prickly Fruit^000000 back for me?
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
那么，你愿意帮我找回^ff00002个黑暗意志^000000和^ff00002个多刺果实^000000吗？

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
The monsters that attack
Tarlock's Airship should
have them. I'd appreciate
it if you'd help me out on
this, adventurer. Thanks
in advance and good luck~
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
袭击塔洛克飞空艇的魔物应该带着这些东西。愿意帮忙的话，我就感激不尽。先谢过你了，祝好运~

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
Oh this is great! Finally,
I have my stuff back! Still,
I have no idea why Tarlock
wanted these things to begin
with. Oh well. Would you please take this reply to Tarlock for me?
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
太好了！终于找回我的东西了！不过我还是不明白塔洛克为什么想要它们。算了。请帮我把这封回信带给他吧。

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
Thanks again
for all of your help!
I don't think I'd ever
see these things again
if it weren't for you~
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
再次感谢你帮忙！要不是你，我恐怕再也找不回这些东西了~

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou have received
Captain Ferlock's letter
to deliver to his elder
brother, Captain Tarlock.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你收到裴陆船长写给哥哥塔洛克船长的回信。^000000

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
Oh, I'm sorry, but it looks
like you're missing something.
Would you please go and find
^ff00002 Will of the Darkness^000000 and
^ff00002 Prickly Fruit^000000? Thanks,
brave adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
抱歉，看起来你还缺东西。请帮我找来^ff00002个黑暗意志^000000和^ff00002个多刺果实^000000。谢谢你，勇敢的冒险者~

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
Well, I hope that
you enjoy your time
here on the Airship
and that you have a
very pleasant journey.
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
希望你在飞空艇上度过愉快时光，旅途顺利。

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
If you need me to
do anything, just
give me a holler.
Bweh heh... hollah~
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
如果你需要我做什么，尽管大声喊我。
嘿嘿... 嘿~

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
Howdy, howdy~
Welcome to the Airship.
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
你好，你好~欢迎来到飞空艇。

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
Oh hey, it's you~
We talked earlier,
didn't we? Yeah...
I'm still here sweeping
this floor. It's gonna
take quite a while.
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
哦嘿，是你呀~我们之前聊过，对吧？
是的...我还在扫这地板呢。
这得花上好一会儿。

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
I'm so sick and
tired of sweeping.
It's like I'm some
kinda lame cabin boy.
But... I guess I am!
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
^333333*叹气...*^000000
扫地真是烦死了。感觉自己像个蹩脚的小水手...不过，我好像确实就是！

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
Hey, thanks for delivering
that letter to Kaci for me.
She wasn't too happy that
I asked a passenger to do
it, but she understood that
I'm totally swamped with work.
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
谢谢你帮我把信送给凯西。她不太高兴我让乘客代劳，不过也明白我忙得不可开交。

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
Hey, hey~ How's it going?
I know, I know, I'm supposed
to be sweeping, and I'm not
finished yet, but sometimes,
you know, you just have to
rest and take a break, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
嘿嘿，最近怎么样？我知道，我知道，我该扫地，而且还没扫完...可有时总得歇一会儿，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
Hey, have you learned
what makes such a big,
heavy Airship like this fly
for so long in the sky?
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
嘿，你知道是什么让这么大、这么重的飞空艇能长时间飞在天上吗？

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
So the Rune Stone
is an imitation of just
a piece of Ymir's Heart.
But where have I heard
about that before...?
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
所以符文石只是仿造的一小块尤弥尔之心...可我以前在哪儿听说过来着？

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
Hey, why don't you
ask Kaci about that
drunkard that's always
playing her Dice game?
You might learn more about
Ymir's Heart Piece, you know?
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
嘿，去问问凯西那个总玩她骰子游戏的酒鬼吧。说不定能从他那里打听到更多关于尤弥尔之心碎片的事。

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
Thanks for helping me
out that last time. I guess
learning about the Rune Stone
kinda inspired me to build an
Airship of my own someday...
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
谢谢你上次帮忙。了解符文石让我很受启发，也许有一天我也能造一艘自己的飞空艇...

scripts.text: Hey, do you know a guy named Thierry?
scripts.translation: 嘿，你认识一个叫蒂埃里的人吗？

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
Thierry? Um...I don't think so. Why don't you go ask Kaci? She might know.
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
蒂埃里？嗯...我不认识。去问问凯西吧，她可能知道。

scripts.text: I'm not a passenger.
scripts.translation: 我不是乘客

scripts.text: Hey kid, what are you doing?
scripts.translation: 嘿，小孩，你在干什么？

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
Does that mean you're
one of the crewmen, then?
I don't think we've met before,
and I should be familiar with
everyone working here by now...
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
那你是船员吗？我不记得见过你，而且这里的船员我应该都认识了...

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
Hey...!
If you're on duty,
shouldn't you be in
uniform? I guess you
don't work here after all!
Heh, figured it out myself~
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
嘿...！如果你在值班，怎么没穿制服？看来你不是这里的员工！嘿嘿，我自己猜出来了~

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
Eh, I need to finish
sweeping this deck. Then,
on my break, I can play a
little game for Apples with
Kaci. That's how I roll, yo.
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
我得先扫完甲板。休息时再和凯西玩苹果骰子游戏。我就是这么过日子的，伙计。

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
Ummm... Isn't it obvious?
I'm sweeping the deck. I'm
the youngest crewman, so
I get stuck with the lamest
jobs. But once I'm done, it's
Dice time with Kaci. Oh yeah~
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
嗯...这还用问吗？我在扫甲板。我是最年轻的船员，所以总被派去干最无聊的活。干完就能和凯西玩骰子啦。哦耶~

scripts.text: Kaci?
scripts.translation: 凯西？

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
Kaci... You know, the
dealer of the Dice game?
You should try it out: just
roll some dice for a chance
to win some Apples. Hey,
you could get really lucky!
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
凯西？就是主持骰子游戏的荷官。你也试试吧，掷骰子有机会赢苹果！说不定你运气很好呢。

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
Heh, there's one guy that
won so many Apples from Kaci
that he was able to become
an Apple Merchant. Can you
believe that? Yeah... Kaci
doesn't like him so much...
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
嘿，有个人从凯西那儿赢了好多苹果，最后都当上苹果商人了！难以置信吧？凯西可不太喜欢他...

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
It doesn't look like
I'm gonna finish this
anytime soon. Hey, do
you think you could do
me a favor since I can't
really leave this joint?
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
看来我一时半会儿扫不完。嘿，我走不开，你能帮我个忙吗？

scripts.text: Sorry, but I'm busy...
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我很忙

scripts.text: What is it?
scripts.translation: 什么事？

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
Eh, alright. I guess
I can understand. But
still, I coulda made it
worth your while, if you
know what I mean~
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
呃，好吧，我理解。不过，你要是帮忙，我本来可以给你点好处的，你懂的~

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
Don't worry, it's not much
work. I'm supposed to deliver
letters from Juno Airport to
the other crewmen, but I don't
got the time. Now, I have
this letter for Kaci here...
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
别担心，不是什么重活。我本该把朱诺机场送来的信分发给其他船员，可实在没时间。这里有封给凯西的信...

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
Would you go and
deliver this letter
to her for me? It's
from some guy named
Mr. Mawong, her mentor
or something like that.
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
能帮我把这封信交给凯西吗？寄信人是马翁先生，好像是她的导师之类的。

scripts.text:
^3355FFHallen gave you
Mawong's letter to
be delivered to Kaci.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF哈伦给了你马翁先生的信，请转交给凯西。^000000

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
Hey, thanks a lot, pal~
You can find Kaci hosting
the Dice game in the Airship.
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
嘿，多谢啦~凯西在飞空艇上主持骰子游戏，你在那里就能找到她。

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
Oh hey, were you
able to give that
letter to Kaci yet?
I think it's pretty
important, so try not
to take too long, okay?
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
嘿，你把那封信交给凯西了吗？我觉得挺重要的，别拖太久，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
Wouldn't you agree
that people should
help each other in
times of crisis?
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
你不觉得人在危难时应该互相帮助吗？

scripts.text: Not at all. Every man for himself!
scripts.translation: 才不呢，各人自顾自！

scripts.text: Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 是啊，我同意。

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
Wh-what...?
I can't think
that you really
believe that...
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
什...什么？我不敢相信你真这么想...

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
Aww, really?
I knew that you'd
feel the same way
I do. You and me, we're
on the same wavelength~
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
哇，真的吗？我就知道你和我想的一样。咱俩真是心有灵犀~

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
Oh... Hey, I was
going to give you
a little something,
but you're carrying
too much stuff right now...
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
哦...我本来想送你点小礼物，可你的背包已经塞满了...

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
I know this isn't
much, but I'd like you
to have it. Besides, you
never know what'll come in
handy during an emergency.
Alright then, see you later~
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
我知道这不算什么，但还是想送给你。紧急时刻说不定能派上用场。那回头见~

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
Ahh, busy days like these
remind me of working back
home in Juno with my neighbor,
Gyver. He's a genius inventor,
you know, and sort of like
a hero or role model to me.
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
啊，这样忙碌的日子让我想起在朱诺老家和邻居盖弗一起工作的时光。他是个天才发明家，也是我的英雄和榜样。

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
Guyver is so brilliant,
he can pretty much make
anything he wants. Someday,
I want to reach his level, and
create things that will help
people and make them happy.
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
盖弗聪明绝顶，几乎什么都能造出来。总有一天我也要达到他的水平，造出能帮助别人、让大家开心的东西。

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
That's pretty much my
life ambition-- you know,
the kind of thing I want to
contribute to the world. Of
course, I doubt I can compare
to the great Sage Varmunt.
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
这差不多就是我的人生目标——为这个世界做点贡献。当然，我不敢和伟大的贤者巴尔蒙德相提并论。

scripts.text: Sage Varmunt?
scripts.translation: 贤者巴尔蒙德？

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
Yeah, Varmunt... He's like
one of the greatest Sages in
history. Well, nobody know too
much about him, but 300 years
ago, he was responsible for most ground breaking accomplishments.
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
巴尔蒙德是历史上最伟大的贤者之一。虽然关于他的事所知不多，但300年前，他创造了许多划时代的成就。

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
Supposedly, he single handedly
revolutionized science. Many of
the machines that are convenient to life today are his inventions.
Sadly, he disappeared from history and no one know how he vanished.
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
据说他一手推动了科学革命。如今许多方便生活的机器都是他发明的。可惜他从历史上消失了，没人知道他去了哪里。

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
The great Sage Varmunt...
It's a pretty well known
legend in the Schwarzwald
Republic. Anyway, for my
project, I wanted to learn
more about these Airships.
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
伟大的贤者巴尔蒙德...在修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国，这是个家喻户晓的传说。总之，我想为自己的项目多了解些飞空艇。

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
These Airships are so huge
and heavy, and I can scarcely
believe that they can fly. How
is it even possible? Well, if
you could find out for me, 
it'd be a really big help.
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
飞空艇又大又重，我简直不敢相信它能飞。这究竟是怎么做到的？你要是能帮我查清楚就太好了。

scripts.text: Umm, yeah, kind of.
scripts.translation: 嗯，是的，大概吧

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
Really...?
Are you serious?
So what's the secret?
Tell me, I'm dying to know!
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
真的...？你没开玩笑吧？秘密是什么？快告诉我，我都等不及了！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou tell Hallen everything
that you've learned from
Captain Tarlock, but you're
careful not to make any
mention of Ymir's Heart Piece.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你把从塔洛克船长那里打听到的事都告诉了哈伦，但谨慎地没提尤弥尔之心碎片。^000000

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
So... The propellers are
powered through steam?
That doesn't make sense.
No way, it can't be that simple. Besides, steam has its limits.
Are you sure that's everything?
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
所以...螺旋桨靠蒸汽驱动？这说不通啊。蒸汽的力量有限，不可能这么简单。你确定没有别的了吗？

scripts.text: Actually, there's another power source.
scripts.translation: 实际上，还有另一种动力源

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou reveal what you
learn about the Rune Stone,
an imitation of Ymir's Heart
Piece: Hallen is a well meaning
kid who probably won't use this
knowledge for evil purposes.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你告诉哈伦符文石是尤弥尔之心碎片的仿制品。哈伦心地善良，应该不会拿这消息去做坏事。

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
A-awesome! So there is
some special magic power
source that helps this Airship
fly! I knew it! Now, what was
it called again? Ah, the
Rune Stone, right?
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
太棒了！看来确实有特殊的魔力能源帮助飞空艇飞行！我就知道！那东西叫什么来着？啊，符文石，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
An imitation of Ymir's
Heart Piece. Now where
have I heard about that
before? Mm, let me think...
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
尤弥尔之心碎片的仿制品...我在哪儿听过来着？嗯，让我想想...

scripts.text: Actually...
scripts.translation: 实际上

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
You didn't learn anything
about the Airship yet, huh?
Maybe Captain Ferlock might
know something, or any one
of the other Airship captains.
Hopefully, one will tell you...
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
你还没打听到飞空艇的秘密吧？也许裴陆船长或其他船长知道些什么。希望他们有人愿意告诉你...

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
I know that the secrets of
Airship flight is considered
classified information, but if
anyone can wrest those secrets,
it'll be one of you adventurers. So please help me out here...
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
我知道飞空艇的飞行秘密属于机密，但冒险者里总有人能打听到。拜托，帮帮我...

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
Oh, that's right!
Kaci told me about a
drunkard that always
mentions Ymir's Heart
when he plays the Dice
game for Apples!
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
哦，对了！凯西说有个酒鬼玩苹果骰子时总提到尤弥尔之心！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(^333333Wait, I met that guy when
I was helping Shinokas. He
was one of the directors of
the Einbroch Laboratory that
had a piece of Ymir's Heart.
It's worth investigating...^000000)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(^333333等等，我帮西怒卡斯时见过那人。他是艾音布罗克实验室的总监之一，那里有块尤弥尔之心。值得调查...^000000)

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
Anyway, it's not much,
but let me give you a little
something for going through
the trouble of learning that
secret information for me...
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
总之，虽然礼物不贵重，但谢谢你费心帮我打听这个秘密。请收下...

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
Aw, nuts...
You don't have
enough room to
receive my little gift.
Please free up more space
in your inventory for me, okay?
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
哎呀...你的背包空间不够，装不下我的小礼物。
腾些地方出来再来，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Hallen]
Here you go~
I know it's pretty paltry
compared to the rewards 
you adventurers usually get,
but hey... It's my thought that
counts, right? See you later~
scripts.translation:
[哈伦]
给你~我知道这比不上冒险者平常拿到的奖励，不过礼轻情意重，对吧？回头见~

scripts.text:
[Kaci]
You must be sooo
bored, adventurer~
How would you like
to play a game of Dice?
scripts.translation:
[凯西]
你一定很无聊吧，冒险者~想不想玩一局掷骰子？

scripts.text:
[Kaci]
Oh, hello. Thanks for
delivering that letter from
Mr. Mawong to me, especially
since Hallen was too busy to
do it himself. Reading that
letter really made my day~
scripts.translation:
[凯西]
你好，谢谢你替哈伦把马翁先生的信送来。他忙得没法亲自送，真是帮大忙了。读了这封信，我今天心情都好了~

scripts.text:
[Kaci]
Hello, {0}.
It's nice to see you again.
So is there anything I can
help you with today?
scripts.translation:
[凯西]
你好，{0}。很高兴再见到你。今天有什么需要我帮忙的吗？

scripts.text:
[Kaci]
The airship captain might be able to help you in finding Thierry's whereabouts.
scripts.translation:
[凯西]
飞空艇船长或许能帮你打听蒂埃里的下落。

scripts.text: Do you know a guy named Thierry?
scripts.translation: 你认识一个叫蒂埃里的人吗？

scripts.text:
[Kaci]
Thierry? Um...that sounds familiar...
scripts.translation:
[凯西]
蒂埃里？嗯...这名字听起来有点耳熟...

scripts.text:
[Kaci]
Oh, right! Thierry, Thierry, Thierry! Right?
scripts.translation:
[凯西]
哦，对了！蒂埃里，蒂埃里，蒂埃里！是他吧？

scripts.text:
[Kaci]
- She suddenly called out the name several times,  -
- so you were startled and dropped your half eaten apple. -
scripts.translation:
[凯西]
- 她突然连喊了好几遍那个名字， -
- 吓得你手里的半个苹果掉在地上。 -

scripts.text:
[Kaci]
Oops, sorry, if I startled you. I could not remember the name because it has been a while since I heard of his name the last time.
scripts.translation:
[凯西]
哎呀，吓到你了，对不起。我好久没听到他的名字，一时没想起来。

scripts.text:
[Kaci]
Thierry was a guy living in the next door while I was learning games and tricks from Mr. Mawong.
I remember that he was a very smart guy and was doing many research stuffs.
scripts.translation:
[凯西]
我向马翁先生学习游戏和技巧时，蒂埃里就住在隔壁。我记得他很聪明，做过不少研究。

scripts.text:
[Kaci]
Oh yeah, and he was in love with Eukran's sister.
And Eukran and I were studying games together under Mr. Mawong at that time.
Hmm...I wonder how they have been doing.
scripts.translation:
[凯西]
哦对，他爱上了尤斯兰的妹妹。当时尤斯兰和我都跟着马翁先生学习游戏。
嗯...不知道他们现在怎么样了。

scripts.text: - You told her that Euslan and Thierry got engaged, but Thierry had to leave her to find medicine for her illness. -
scripts.translation: - 你告诉她，尤斯兰和蒂埃里已经订婚，但蒂埃里为了寻找治疗她疾病的药物，不得不离开她。 -

scripts.text:
[Kaci]
Oh...gosh...I can't believe that Euslan is has become ill....Oh......
scripts.translation:
[凯西]
哦...天哪...真不敢相信尤斯兰病了...

scripts.text:
- Kaci seemed to be shocked by such devastating news. -
- She was mumbling something for a while, and then came back to her senses again. -
scripts.translation:
- 凯西似乎被这个沉重的消息打击到了。 -
- 她喃喃自语了一会儿，才回过神来。 -

scripts.text:
[Kaci]
I am so sorry for her...I really want to give here some help...but, it has been a while for me since I saw them. So, I don't know where he is.
scripts.translation:
[凯西]
我很同情她...真想帮帮她...可是我已经很久没见过他们了，也不知道蒂埃里在哪儿。

scripts.text:
[Kaci]
But, let me think if...
scripts.translation:
[凯西]
不过，让我想想...

scripts.text:
[Kaci]
Oh, right! The airship captain might be able to help you, because he is the one who is in charge of the passenger list.
scripts.translation:
[凯西]
哦，对了！船长负责管理乘客名单，也许能帮上忙。

scripts.text:
[Kaci]
Although the passenger list is classified and strictly restricted from releasing to public...
scripts.translation:
[凯西]
虽然乘客名单属于机密，不能随意公开...

scripts.text:
[Kaci]
But, if you tell him the story, he might be able to help you. Please go ask him if you can.
scripts.translation:
[凯西]
不过你把事情经过告诉他，他也许会愿意帮忙。去问问看吧。

scripts.text:
[Kaci]
And if you see Euslan again, please send my regard and blessing to her.
scripts.translation:
[凯西]
如果再见到尤斯兰，请代我向她问好，祝她平安。

scripts.text: - You promised her to send her regards and blessings to Euslan. -
scripts.translation: - 你答应替她向尤斯兰转达问候与祝福。 -

scripts.text: Give her the letter from Hallen.
scripts.translation: 把哈伦的信交给她

scripts.text:
[Kaci]
Oh, Hallen must have
asked you to deliver this.
He should be doing this sort
of thing himself, instead of
asking customers for favors!
But still, he's really busy...
scripts.translation:
[凯西]
哦，哈伦让你送来的吧？这种事他应该自己做，别总麻烦乘客！
不过，他确实很忙...

scripts.text:
[Kaci]
Thank you for bringing
this to me. If you ever
need a little favor from
me, feel free to ask me,
alright? See you later~
scripts.translation:
[凯西]
谢谢你把信送来。以后需要我帮小忙，尽管开口。回头见~

scripts.text:
[Kaci]
Please don't hesitate
to ask me anything if
you need a small favor,
or if you're just curious
about me in general~
scripts.translation:
[凯西]
需要我帮忙，或者只是对我感到好奇，都尽管问~

scripts.text: Ask about Hallen
scripts.translation: 询问关于哈伦的事

scripts.text: Ask about Mawong
scripts.translation: 询问关于马翁的事

scripts.text: Ask about the Airship
scripts.translation: 询问关于飞空艇的事

scripts.text:
[Kaci]
Hallen? Well, he and I are
pretty close. Did you know
that we're cousins? In fact,
his dad, my uncle, brought
me as a child after my father
passed away 20 years ago.
scripts.translation:
[凯西]
哈伦？我和他关系很亲近。我们是表兄妹。20年前父亲去世后，是他的父亲、也就是我叔叔，把我接回家抚养。

scripts.text:
[Kaci]
There was some kind of
mine explosion accident in
Einbech. I don't remember.
Anyway, me and Hallen are
like sister and brother, and
we always stick together.
scripts.translation:
[凯西]
当时艾音贝赫发生过矿场爆炸事故，我记不清具体情况了。总之，我和哈伦就像亲姐弟，总是形影不离。

scripts.text:
[Kaci]
When Captain Ferlock saw me
host a Dice game by coincidence
and then hired me to work on his Airship, Hallen insisted on coming
along. He's stubborn like that,
but he's also very sweet.
scripts.translation:
[凯西]
裴陆船长偶然看见我主持骰子游戏，就雇我上飞空艇工作。哈伦坚持要跟来。他就是这么固执，不过也很体贴。

scripts.text:
[Kaci]
Mr. Mawong? Oh, don't get
the wrong idea! He's my
mentor, the one who taught
me how to play all of these
wonderful games. He's pretty
famous around Juno, you know.
scripts.translation:
[凯西]
马翁先生？别误会，他是我的导师，教我玩这些有趣的游戏。他在朱诺可是很有名的。

scripts.text:
[Kaci]
I used to be so depressed,
not caring about the world
at all, after my father died.
Then, I ran into Mr. Mawong,
and he taught me how to find
the joy in life once again.
scripts.translation:
[凯西]
父亲去世后，我一度非常消沉，对什么都不关心。后来遇到马翁先生，他教我重新找到生活的乐趣。

scripts.text:
[Kaci]
Because of him, I decided
to learn his games and to
help people forget their
worries and just enjoy
themselves, even if it's
just for a little while.
scripts.translation:
[凯西]
多亏了他，我决定学会这些游戏，帮人们暂时忘掉烦恼、尽情享受片刻时光。

scripts.text:
[Kaci]
The Airship? It's so
huge and beautiful, and
I'm always amazed that it
can fly so gracefully through
the air. I've always wanted to live someplace close to the sky...
scripts.translation:
[凯西]
飞空艇？它又大又漂亮，我总惊叹于它能如此优雅地翱翔天际。我一直梦想住在离天空很近的地方...

scripts.text:
[Kaci]
A place where I can see
the clouds and bask in the
sun. So, when Captain Ferlock
invited me to work here, it was
like a dream come true~
scripts.translation:
[凯西]
在那里可以看云、晒太阳。所以裴陆船长邀请我来这里工作时，简直像梦想成真~

scripts.text:
[Kaci]
By the way, if Hallen
bothers you with another
request, please refuse to
help him next time, okay?
I won't allow him to get
spoiled! Ho ho ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[凯西]
对了，要是哈伦又拿别的事麻烦你，下次请拒绝他，好吗？我可不想把他惯坏！呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Kaci]
Well, I better get
back to work now.
Have a nice day,
and I'll see you later~
scripts.translation:
[凯西]
好了，我得回去工作了。祝你今天愉快，下次见~

scripts.text: Who's that drunk over there?
scripts.translation: 那边那个醉汉是谁？

scripts.text:
[Kaci]
Oh, him? He's one of my
regulars, some guy who's
supposed to be an Einbroch
Lab Director. He keeps losing
Apples whenever he plays Dice:
I think he's a gambling addict~
scripts.translation:
[凯西]
哦，他是我的常客，据说是艾音布罗克实验室的总监。每次玩骰子他都会输掉苹果，我看他是个赌徒~

scripts.text:
[Kaci]
In fact, his losses make up
for all the Apples I lost when
that Apple Merchant played here. Now, it's a legendary tale that
we all think fondly of, but at
the time, it nearly broke me.
scripts.translation:
[凯西]
他输掉的苹果，正好弥补了之前那个苹果商人来玩时我输掉的那些。如今这成了大家津津乐道的传奇，可当时差点把我逼疯。

scripts.text:
[Kaci]
Anyway, aside from the fact
that the Einbroch Lab Director
is kind of a whiny person when
he's drunk, and a poor gambler,
I don't know much about him.
scripts.translation:
[凯西]
总之，除了知道这位艾音布罗克实验室总监喝醉后爱抱怨、赌技又差之外，我对他一无所知。

[Ferlock]
Excuse me, but are
you an employee here?
I've come to pick up a
new Rune Stone for the
Airship. Wait, wait...
You look familiar...
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
打扰一下，你是这里的员工吗？
我来为飞空艇领取新的符文石。等等...你看起来很面熟...

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
That's right, aren't you the
one who brought me my
brother's letter? Yeah, you
were asking me about the
Airship's flight mechanics.
So you're not an employee...
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
没错，你就是替我送来哥哥信件的人。你当时还问过飞空艇的飞行原理。
所以你不是这里的员工...

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
Boy, you must be more than
curious to be looking up that
information in a restricted
area. But don't worry, you
must have your reasons,
so I won't call the guards.
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
你肯定好奇得不得了，竟跑到禁区查资料。不过别担心，你一定有自己的理由，我不会叫卫兵。

scripts.text:
[Ferlock]
Still, you better get out
of here. The guards patrol
this place regularly, so you're
almost sure to get caught. Hmm,
come and see me later at the
Airship, alright? Now hurry!
scripts.translation:
[裴陆]
不过你最好赶紧离开。卫兵经常巡逻，你很快就会被发现。之后来飞空艇找我。快走！
